prompts.text: When you like someone, what gives you away before you say a word?
We run into each other at a bookshop and have ten minutes to talk. What section are you taking me to first?
A teasing voice note after work or a thoughtful message waiting when you wake up?
Someone remembering a tiny detail from your story feels more romantic than an expensive surprise. Agree?
Which ordinary part of your day would you secretly enjoy sharing with someone new?
We both reach for the last slice of cake. How are you negotiating ownership?
Tell me about a compliment someone gave you that stayed in your head longer than expected.
A conversation sometimes feels different when neither person rushes to fill a pause. Have you noticed?
What sort of harmless teasing makes you laugh rather than roll your eyes?
Would you rather trade favourite songs or swap the most embarrassing photos on your camera roll?
A café loses our reservation, so we have to improvise. Where does the afternoon go?
How do you usually tell when a friendly conversation has turned into flirting?
A shared inside joke tells you more about chemistry than a perfect first date does. What's your verdict?
Has a completely unplanned conversation ever made you want to see someone again? What happened?
What would make a first walk together feel easy rather than awkward?
A silly nickname you both understand or a private playlist with a ridiculous title?
We join a trivia night as a team. Which category are you trusting yourself to carry?
Which habit of yours tends to surprise people once they get past your first impression?
Sometimes the sweetest part of a date is the conversation on the way home. Would you agree?
Would you rather someone notice your confidence or your kindness first, and why?
You're showing me one place in your neighbourhood that means something to you. Where are we going?
An unexpected afternoon adventure or a relaxed evening with endless conversation?
What is your favourite way for someone to show interest without putting pressure on you?
A little awkwardness makes a first meeting more memorable. Are you buying it?
Tell me about a time someone's sense of humour completely changed your opinion of them.
We're cooking together for the first time. Which job are you assigning me, and what are you making?
If someone asked your best friend what you're like when you have a crush, what story would they tell?
Getting a handwritten note in your bag or finding a funny photo someone printed for you?
Remembering how someone takes their tea sounds small until they remember yours. Does that matter to you?
What topic makes you forget you're meant to be playing it cool?
We're stuck in traffic for an hour without music. What conversation would save the journey?
Good timing matters almost as much as mutual interest when two people start talking. Agree or disagree?
Which question would you love someone to ask you on a first date but hardly anyone does?
Would you choose a competitive board game or a slightly chaotic art class for an early date?
Have you ever gone home from meeting someone and replayed one funny moment all evening?
I hand you the aux cable on our first drive. What's the first song you play to make an impression?
What kind of attention makes you feel seen without making you feel watched?
Being comfortable admitting you're nervous is more attractive than pretending you never are. Thoughts?
A short spontaneous call or a long conversation that starts with one random meme?
What is one surprisingly charming thing someone does without realising it?
You get to pick a tiny challenge for us on our next outing. What are we competing over?
Two people laughing at an ordinary mistake often feels like a better start than a flawless introduction. True?
What's an unexpected shared interest that would make you instantly more curious about someone?
Tell me about the most creative but respectful way someone started a conversation with you.
One meaningful question over dinner or a dozen silly questions during a long walk?
It's raining just as our outdoor plan begins. Do we find somewhere cosy or embrace the weather?
Which small act of consideration tells you a person pays attention to your comfort?
Keeping a little mystery at the talking stage is fun only when both people communicate clearly. Agree?
We each have to teach the other one tiny skill in fifteen minutes. What are you teaching me?
What would make you feel comfortable saying, 'I'd like to see you again,' without second-guessing yourself?
